Description=Primary transit static-route health watcher

[Service]

--- primary-transit watcher script ---
#!/bin/sh

PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
PRIMARY_IF=enp8s0
PRIMARY_PEER=10.84.0.3
PRIMARY_SRC=10.84.10.2
STANDBY_IF=enp9s0
STANDBY_GATEWAY=10.84.1.254
REMOTE_ENDPOINT=10.84.10.3

failures=0
successes=0
state=unknown

while :; do
    if ping -n -c 1 -W 1 -I "$PRIMARY_IF" "$PRIMARY_PEER" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        failures=0
        if [ "$state" = primary ]; then
            successes=0
        else
            successes=$((successes + 1))
            if [ "$successes" -ge 2 ]; then
                if ip route replace "$REMOTE_ENDPOINT/32" via "$PRIMARY_PEER" dev "$PRIMARY_IF" src "$PRIMARY_SRC" metric 10 proto static >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                    ip route replace "$REMOTE_ENDPOINT/32" via "$STANDBY_GATEWAY" dev "$STANDBY_IF" src "$PRIMARY_SRC" metric 200 proto static >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
                    state=primary
                    successes=0
                fi
            fi
        fi
    else
        successes=0
        if [ "$state" = standby ]; then
            failures=0
        else
            failures=$((failures + 1))
            if [ "$failures" -ge 2 ]; then
                ip route replace "$REMOTE_ENDPOINT/32" via "$PRIMARY_PEER" dev "$PRIMARY_IF" src "$PRIMARY_SRC" metric 250 proto static >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
                if ip route replace "$REMOTE_ENDPOINT/32" via "$STANDBY_GATEWAY" dev "$STANDBY_IF" src "$PRIMARY_SRC" metric 10 proto static >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                    state=standby
                    failures=0
                fi
            fi
        fi
    fi
    sleep 1
done
